trades.reasoning: QRVO shows full multi-signal confirmation (MACD bullish crossover, RSI 47.6 below 70, price above SMA-20, volume surge), adding diversified semiconductor exposure alongside existing MU position.

decisions.briefing: Markets were flat today with NASDAQ and S&P 500 both up +0.3%, a neutral session with no major moves. We added a single new position in QRVO, a semiconductor name showing strong confirmed momentum signals, while keeping the rest of cash in reserve since the broader market didn't show a clear risk-on signal.

market_education.summary_en: Trading was quiet today, with both the NASDAQ and S&P 500 posting modest gains of about 0.3%, suggesting investors are in a wait-and-see mode rather than reacting to any major catalyst. Without a strong directional push, most stocks drifted sideways rather than showing clear breakouts. This kind of low-volatility day often reflects markets digesting recent moves before the next catalyst, such as earnings or economic data, arrives.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市交投淡靜，納斯達克指數及標普500指數同步微升約0.3%，反映投資者普遍採取觀望態度，未見有明顯催化劑刺激市場。在缺乏強烈方向性因素下，大部分股份只係橫行整理，未見明顯突破。呢種低波幅走勢通常反映市場正消化近期升跌，等候下一個刺激因素，例如企業盈利或經濟數據公佈。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Momentum confirmation means waiting for multiple technical signals — like a MACD crossover, healthy RSI, price above a moving average, and a volume surge — to all line up before buying, rather than acting on just one signal. This reduces the chance of chasing a false or short-lived move.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 動量確認係指喺買入之前，等待多個技術訊號——例如MACD黃金交叉、健康嘅RSI水平、股價高於移動平均線，以及成交量放大——同時出現，而唔係單靠一個訊號就落實交易。呢個做法可以減少追錯虛假或短暫升浪嘅機會。
